jobs.description: To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.Your mission- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilitiesYour profile- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)- Fluent in English and preferably GermanBenefits- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discountsYour next step - get in touch!We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

Do you want to contribute to protecting energy systems of the future and secure OT infrastructure in Renewable Energy? Then apply to become part of an international and market-leading asset management consultancy within the renewable energy industry. PEAK Wind is looking for a Cyber Security Consultant, who wants to take their cyber security career to the next level and is looking to work on a diverse and exciting portfolio within wind power and other renewable Energy sources.Trusted Advisors for Developers and Investors for some of the Largest Renewable AssetsAt PEAK Wind, we specialise in operations, asset management, and project management of Renewable Energy assets and take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. We work with some of the world’s largest infrastructure investments and are proud to count market-leading utilities, investment funds, and independent power producers among our clients.Job Content, Responsibilities, and Possibilities:Based in one of our offices in Denmark (Aarhus and Copenhagen), or Germany (Hamburg) you will be working in a team supporting customer projects and programs within the field of IT/OT and cyber security. We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative working environment. SCADA and Cyber Security is a crucial area for our clients, who we support on both greenfield and brownfield projects. The team works across disciplines, ensuring seamless integration, operation, and cyber security of OT, ICS, and SCADA systems.Your responsibilities include:- Leading risk assessments of IT/OT environments for clients across large-scale renewable assets, and providing risk mitigation strategies and recommendations.- Developing IT/OT operating models, guidelines, and procedures for renewable assets.- Developing and communicating IT/OT infrastructure designs to our customers.- Implementing cyber security solutions for IT and OT environments on large-scale renewable assets, and reporting to project management, customers directly, and/or other senior engineering functions.- Adapt to legislation and regulatory requirements for the IT/OT environment. Advise on the utilisation of best practices, policies, and standards, such as IEC62443, and ISO27000.- Build strong relationships with stakeholders, in PEAK Wind and among our customers.What you Bring and your QualitiesWe expect that you have a minimum of 2-4 years of experience from a similar position, and previous experience with cyber security functions, such as Risk Management, Vulnerability Assessments, and Security Assessments. Furthermore, experience within security systems including firewalls and security engineering is required. Recognized security certification is desirable and experience with implementation of national standards such as NERC/CIP or NIS2 would be considered an advantage. The ideal candidate would have experience with renewable energy projects and/or implementation of Cyber Security Management Systems in other industries.As a person, you are a team player, and you thrive working in an international and diverse team with mixed cultures and seniorities. You are detail-oriented and possess strong problem-solving skills in IT/OT systems. As PEAK Wind is a global company, you must also have strong English communication skills, both oral and written. Finally, we are looking for a candidate with excellent stakeholder management skills.Experience the Highest Degree of InvolvementPEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity and our values of Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity are materialized through our team members every day. Here you will be able to utilize your financial skills while developing a strong understanding of renewable energy assets. We offer an opportunity to get on board and experience the highest degree of involvement and responsibility in PEAK Wind’s global renewable energy team. Together with the rest of the team, you will play an instrumental part in the continued success of PEAK Wind. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. The position will also offer global exposure as our clients work globally.Interested and want to know more?If you have any questions or want to know more about the position, please contact People & Development via recruitment@peak-wind.com (recruitment@peak-wind.com) . We look forward to receiving your applications & CVs as soon as possible. Please apply through ‘Apply’ at the bottom of the page. Applications will be assessed on an ongoing basis.PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

We take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. SCADA and Cyber Security is a key area for our clients and receives increased attention on both greenfield and brownfield projects. The team works across different disciplines ensuring seamless integration, operation, and Cyber Security of OT, ICS, and SCADA systems.Your responsibilities include:- Drafting and reviewing requirements suppliers and service providers of OT systems, SCADA, and Cyber Security for renewable assets, mainly within onshore and offshore wind- Negotiating SCADA and Cyber Security requirements in various supply and service contracts on behalf of our clients- Designing basic network archtiecture and identifying functional requirements from network designes- Supporting operational teams on OT, SCADA, and Cyber Security investigations and improvements- Identifying and integrating technical upgrades, new systems, and functionalities- Managing sub-suppliers for performance management, defining maintenance, and optimizing the reliabilityExperienced SCADA Consultant with a holistic mindset:We are looking for a candidate with knowledge within OT/SCADA systems and Cyber Security. You have broad experience working with SCADA, critical OT or IT systems, across the array of different systems used in production environments. Furthermore, you are familiar and used to working with security standards such as ISO270xx, IEC62443, NERC-CIP, or similar. Knowledge of industrial computer networks is an advantage but not a requirement.Irrespective of your background, you are solution-oriented and like to find smarter and more efficient ways to solve problems. You are motivated by solving problems and finding solutions that work in the real world and not just on paper. Preferably you have experience in project management or experience from a Supervisor position, which has given you commercial awareness and the ability to work independently. Experience in the wind turbine industry will also be considered an advantage.The ideal candidate is self-driven, proactive, and has a solution-oriented attitude. You are a good communicator with a proven ability to build sound business relationships and represent them in project meetings and presentations.
